title: MOJA Saltz Peach Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Moja Saltz Peach Ice is a perfectly balanced fruit cooler. It features the soft, delicate, and juicy taste of ripe Peaches on the inhale, followed by a crisp, refreshing blast of ice on the exhale for a clean finish. The Moja Saltz collection (formerly known as Moja Juice) is crafted by Liberty Flights here in the UK. Formulated with a double concentration of flavour, these e-liquids are designed to deliver an exceptionally punchy and consistent taste experience. This ensures maximum flavour clarity and intensity, even when used in low-power starter kits. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It pairs perfectly with refillable pod kits, delivering discreet vapour and crystal-clear flavour. The premium nicotine salt formulation ensures a super-smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Moja Saltz Nic Salts are available in 10mg and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
